_comment: recall@N for the data-plane search in mcp/discovery.py. Deterministic by design: the catalogue is snapshotted here, so the score moves only when the RANKING changes — no MCP subprocess, no network, no model key. This is the gate Phase 2 needed and the offline suite could not otherwise provide: its other six scores measure maths and would not move at all if tool selection regressed. `expect` may list several tools: more than one provider legitimately answers most questions, which is what capability tags are for.
